value.rationale: The natural triangular graph L(K_n) models uniform antiferromagnetic interactions among edges incident to common vertices. Its entire zero-temperature finite-size field response is classified exactly, including all crossings and labelled multiplicities via a coefficient formula. At every odd n>=5 a parity-protected magnetic defect changes from a P3 plus disjoint matching to an isolated vertex plus matching at the sharp field h=2J(n-3); this yields a discrete two-unit magnetization jump absent at even n. This offers a complete finite-state frustration benchmark, not a routine special-case arithmetic evaluation or thermodynamic transition claim.
